brand.rule: config.assets names and formats are unchanged. Images the bot sends as full pictures stay within 720-1080 (sections, menu banner, prayer and UI cards 1280x720; rules, registration and default avatar 1080x1080; promote 1280x959; demote 867x1280); images it embeds as message thumbnails keep a small size (WhatsApp thumbnail limit). Every image is rendered at 2x, then downscaled (lanczos) and lightly sharpened. The handwriting paper stays 1024x784 (the size the command writes on).
